students.title: Class List
students.item1: Create as many classes as you like in the class manager and switch between them – each class keeps its own students and seating plans.
students.item2: Add students one by one, create placeholders for a whole class, or import a CSV file – "What the file looks like" shows the required structure.
students.item3: Select up to 3 preferred and distance partners per student – the order determines priority.
students.item4: Search, filter and sorting help you find individual students; the checkboxes let you edit several students at once.
students.item5: Add photos in the inspector via the portrait – they stay on this device only.
students.item6: Undo and redo changes in the class list with the corresponding icons in the status bar.

layout.title: Classroom
layout.item1: While nothing is selected, “Set up from scratch” in the inspector places tables for the whole class. A click or a tap puts a single table on a free spot, or you drag it from the toolbar into the room.
layout.item2: Move and rotate tables via drag & drop, or with the arrow keys and Q/E.
layout.item3: Multi-select: Shift+click, Ctrl/⌘+click or draw a selection rectangle.
layout.item4: Right-click (desktop) or long press (touch) opens the context menu.
layout.item5: Under “Templates” in the inspector you save the room for other classes and load saved rooms.
layout.item6: Room elements such as windows, door, desk, blackboard, whiteboard, cabinet or divider go onto a free spot with a click or a tap, or you drag them from the toolbar into the room; resize them if needed.
layout.item7: Undo and redo changes in the classroom with the corresponding icons in the status bar.

plan.title: Seating Plan
plan.item1: In the inspector on the right you set how much each criterion matters – Off, Consider, Important or Very important – or pick a recipe that sets them all at once.
plan.item2: Drag students to other seats – on a taken seat the two swap. Esc cancels the drag. With the keyboard, Enter picks a student up, the arrow keys choose the seat, Enter puts them down.
plan.item3: Click the lock icon to lock a seat for the next mix.
plan.item4: The button above the criteria shows in per cent how well the plan meets them and puts a bar under each criterion – hover it and the seats it concerns are marked.
plan.item5: The view settings control how names appear (first name only, first name + initial, or first and last name) and whether photos are shown.
plan.item6: Undo and redo changes to the seating plan with the corresponding icons in the status bar.
plan.item7: Hover over or tap an icon on a seat to see what it means – the seats of everyone who shares it are marked. Under “Markers” in the toolbar you find the legend, choose which icons the seats show and switch the explanation and the marking off.

circle.title: Seating Circle
circle.item1: Drag students to other places in the circle – the two swap. Esc cancels the drag.
circle.item2: Green lines show connections to table neighbors in the seating plan.
circle.item3: Show or hide connections in the toolbar under “View settings”.
circle.item4: The circle is built from the seating plan and can be changed. “Save plan” keeps it together with the plan; you can export and present it on its own.
circle.item5: Hover over or tap an icon on a seat to see what it means – the seats of everyone who shares it are marked. Under “Markers” in the toolbar you find the legend, choose which icons the seats show and switch the explanation and the marking off.
circle.item6: The lock keeps a student in their place in the circle: dragging, shuffling and regenerating leave them there. With the keyboard, Enter picks a student up, the arrow keys choose the place, Enter puts them down.
circle.item7: Undo and redo changes to the seating circle with the corresponding icons in the status bar.

export.title: Export
export.item1: Customize the name of your seating plan.
export.item2: Switch between portrait and landscape format for PDF export.
export.itemFlip: Set the viewing direction under page format: "From the back" rotates the room by 180° for a desk at the back, so names stay readable.
export.item3: Choose in the inspector on the right what the sheet carries: special needs, photos, legend, class info and room elements.
export.itemNames: Choose how names appear: first name only, first name + last name initial, or first and last name.
export.item4: Switch between seating plan and seating circle in the toolbar on the left.
export.item5: Besides PDF and print you can save the view as a PNG image or an SVG vector graphic.

present.title: Presentation mode
present.item1: The bar at the bottom switches between teacher and student view as well as between seating plan and circle.
present.item2: The student view shows the plan from the class's perspective – without markers and photos.
present.item3: Show or hide markers, photos, colors and room elements using the bar at the bottom.
present.itemNames: The "Names" button switches the display between first name, first name + last name initial, and first and last name.
present.itemContrast: Contrast mode shows the plan black on white with thicker outlines – so it stays easy to read on the board, even in a bright room.
present.item4: Set the size with the slider, the mouse wheel or two fingers and drag to pan; the centre icon resets the view.
present.item5: Press Alt/⌥+← to return to the generator.
present.item6: "Who's next?" draws a random student and spotlights their seat – everyone gets a turn before anyone repeats.
present.item7: Keyboard: F fullscreen, Space draws a student, Esc resets the draw, + / − zoom, 0 recenters.
present.itemFullscreen: In fullscreen the wall belongs to the plan: the strip on top goes away, and the bar at the bottom appears when the pointer nears the bottom edge or you tap there, then slides away again shortly after.

library.title: Library
library.item1: Your classes are on the left, beside them the rooms of the chosen class and inside those its plans – like folders in a file manager.
library.item2: What you choose is shown in the inspector: rename it there, move a plan to another room or delete it.
library.item3: “Open” at the bottom right takes the choice into the workspace: a plan to the plan layer, a room to the room layer, a class to the class layer.
library.item4: “Recent mixes” and “Neighbourhoods” belong to the class: its last 20 mixes and who has already sat side by side, across all rooms.
library.item5: “Room templates” belong to every class. A template opens as a new room of the open class.

help.title: Help and tour
help.body: Instructions and keyboard shortcuts for every step are here – and this is where you start the tour again at any time.

emptyState.title: Welcome to Klassenplan!
emptyState.body: Create your first class – or load the sample class and try everything with invented students first.

addStudents.title: Add students
addStudents.body: The toolbar on the left fills the class: one by one, as placeholders or from a CSV file. The sample class sits with the import.

classSwitcher.title: Your classes
classSwitcher.body: The header states which class is open. Switch between classes here, create new ones or rename them. Every class has its own students, rooms and seating plans.

backup.title: Back up your data
backup.body: Your data lives only in this browser. "Backup", at the very bottom of the toolbar, exports an encrypted backup and restores it – on another device, too.

proceed.title: On to the room
proceed.body: Once the list is complete, set up the classroom in the next step.

studentRow.title: Edit students
studentRow.body: Clicking the row opens the student in the inspector. There you set attributes such as restless, shy, language level, social role or preferred and distance partners, and even upload a photo via the portrait.

canvas.title: Your classroom
canvas.body: Move and rotate tables by drag and drop. Right-click or long-press to copy, cut or delete tables.

canvasSettings.title: View settings
canvasSettings.body: Under "View settings" in the toolbar you set what the room shows — every layer with options of its own. Snapping, the grid, alignment guides, photo collisions and room elements are switched here. In the seating plan you choose whether photos appear and how names are shortened, in the circle also whether connections are visible.

proceed.title: On to the seating plan
proceed.body: The first time it opens, Klassenplan mixes a seating plan for you.

sidebar.title: Tables and room elements
sidebar.body: Drag tables, windows, doors or the board into the room, among other things – or put them on a free spot with a click.

setup.title: Set up the room
setup.body: While nothing is selected, the inspector belongs to the room: “Set up from scratch” places as many tables as your class needs, and under “Templates” you load saved rooms or keep this one for other classes.

status.title: Seats at a glance
status.body: Shows whether there are enough seats for all students.

canvas.title: Adjust by hand
canvas.body: Drag students to other seats. A click on the lock icon keeps a student in their seat when mixing.

circle.title: Seating circle
circle.body: Switch between seating plan and seating circle here. The circle is built from the current seating plan and shows table neighbors as connections. You can change it; “Save plan” keeps it together with the plan.

exits.title: Present and export
exits.body: At the bottom right of the status bar you show the plan on the board or export it as a PDF. Both save the plan first when something has changed.

fulfillment.title: Criteria and fulfilment
fulfillment.body: On the right you set which criteria count when mixing and how much they weigh. The button above shows in per cent how well the plan meets them and puts a bar under each criterion — hover it and the seats it concerns are marked, click it to keep the marking.

mix.title: Mix
mix.body: The button in the status bar mixes the class again, taking every selected criterion into account (Ctrl/⌘+Enter).

sidebar.title: Tools
sidebar.body: Switch between seating plan and circle, set what the plan shows and save the plan. The very bottom is the same on every layer: the class tools, the "Library" with your classes, their rooms and plans, and the backup.

sidebarToggle.title: Expand and collapse the toolbar
sidebarToggle.body: This button expands or collapses the toolbar (Ctrl/⌘+B). Collapsed, it shows its functions as icons and leaves more room for the plan.
